assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The overall design site boundary (SITE-001) is a provisional_constraint derived by the agent from the announcement's textual four-extents, the approximate 11.4 km2 area, and road names; it is not an official redline and must not be used as an approval basis or precise area basis.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived metrics (site area, shares, densities) depend on this provisional boundary and must be recomputed once official CAD/GIS/PDF boundary geometry is supplied.

assumptions.statement: The three key detailed-design areas (zhongzhiyuan_ai_acceleration_area, beijing_ai_origin_community, dazhongsi_ai_industry_cluster) are provisional_constraint polygons roughly located to match the announced area figures; their rectangle edges must not be read as parcel or road redlines.
assumptions.impact: Key-area level metrics are indicative only; official key-area polygons will change extents and therefore areas.

assumptions.statement: Recomputed areas differ from the officially announced figures: site 11,412,825.386 sqm vs announced overall design area 11,400,000 sqm (delta 12,825.386 sqm); zhongzhiyuan_ai_acceleration_area 1,929,201.877 sqm vs announced 1,921,000 sqm (delta 8,201.877 sqm); beijing_ai_origin_community 1,043,236.909 sqm vs announced 1,043,000 sqm (delta 236.909 sqm); dazhongsi_ai_industry_cluster 720,454.219 sqm vs announced 720,000 sqm (delta 454.219 sqm). These differences come from the provisional boundary and are within tolerance for intake; they are not authoritative area figures.
assumptions.impact: Do not use the recomputed areas as official land-area values; record the official announced figures from planning_limits.json as the authoritative references.

assumptions.statement: Official planning controls (floor_area_ratio, building_height_m, building_density, green_ratio, setback_m) are marked status=missing in brief/site-package/ranges/planning_limits.json; approved regulatory conditions or official design brief attachments are pending.
assumptions.impact: Metrics for these controls are status=unknown with null values; the design must not be read as meeting statutory FAR/height/density/green/setback limits until official conditions are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, parcel/ownership boundaries, municipal utility alignments, and engineering constraints are not yet available from official sources; road network and site-planning conclusions are conceptual.
assumptions.impact: road_length_m and related network conclusions are design-proposal values only; final setbacks and alignments require official redlines and municipal data.

assumptions.statement: The Qinghe and Xiaoyue River blue-line (river regulation boundary and setback) is pending official confirmation; no official river protection line is included in the site package.
assumptions.impact: Green-blue corridor metrics adjacent to Qinghe/Xiaoyue River are conceptual; final riparian setbacks and flood-protection boundaries may reduce available development area.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual design proposals generated by the agent (confidence low), not official existing building stock or approved development plans.
assumptions.impact: building_footprint_area_sqm is a conceptual footprint total for design massing only and must not be used as an official floor-area or building density basis.

assumptions.statement: Land-use polygons are agent-generated design proposals (land_use.geojson) and do not represent officially approved land-use zoning.
assumptions.impact: land_use_area_*/land_use_share_* metrics describe the design proposal only and require confirmation against official land-use plans.

assumptions.statement: Green-space polygons are conceptual design green/blue network proposals, not official green-space lines.
assumptions.impact: green_space_area_sqm and green_ratio are design-proposal values and differ from the official green_ratio control, which remains unknown.

assumptions.statement: Public-space polygons are conceptual station squares and walkway nodes from the design proposal.
assumptions.impact: public_space_area_sqm and public_space_ratio are design-proposal values to be re-verified once the public-space system is officially defined.

assumptions.statement: Phasing polygons are conceptual near/mid/long-term implementation packages aligned to the three rail segments and are not approved implementation plans.
assumptions.impact: phasing_area_sqm_* values are indicative staging areas and will change with implementation policies and official boundary geometry.
